items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Louis Armstrong, Maxine Sullivan... 'Goin' Places' with Bing Crosby.

ctx.x: Your band wasn't working but Louis was working.
... Louis Armstrong, Maxine Sullivan... 'Goin' Places' with Bing Crosby.
But not the rest of the band? The rest of the band never appeared or played the score or anything like that in the movies?
